About this simulation

Article:
arXiv:2307.02299 — "Why can big.bi be changed to bi.gbi?" (Berthommier, July 5, 2023)
Source code:
github.com/FBerthommier/timit-to-Maeda (synthSYL pipeline) + covtl-pipeline (polar_arc, stationary_point)
Method:
13 segments with a U-shaped Tp variation: Tp=160 ms (start, 2 segments) → decreasing to Tp=0 (middle, 1 segment) → increasing back to Tp=160 ms (end, 2 segments). δ coupled to Tp: δ = 0.5 + 0.5·(1−Tp/160). T=16 (didactic mode). The U-shape lets the listener clearly perceive: ib ib at the start → bi bi at the bottom (fusion Vo=Ve=V) → ib ib again at the end.
Visualization:
Left panel: animated sagittal Maeda vocal tract. Right panel: complex polar plot with vocalic branch z_v (red, K=30, ν=−1) and consonantal branch z_c (blue, K=10, ν=+1), 750 ms fading trail, transient label of current phoneme near its target.
Fusion criterion:
At the bottom of the U (Tp=0, δ=1.00), Vo = Ve = V = (0.9, 5π/3). The schwa-like vocoid (Ve) transforms into the full vowel /i/, and the /b/ moves from coda to onset position, perceptually transforming /ib ib/ into /bi bi/.
Model:
VLAM = Maeda model with 7 parameters (Jaw, Body, Dorsum, Tip, LipP, LipH, Hy).
